levels.description: Guard and Evade improve their favored defense by an extra 15%.
Unlock Foretell: once per combat, guess a selected enemy's next action. A correct guess grants 75% Armor and Evasion for two turns.

effects.name: Foretell
effects.description: Choose an enemy and predict its next action. If correct, gain 75% Armor and Evasion for two turns; if wrong, gain 10% for one turn.

levels.description: Guard and Evade improve their favored defense by another 15%.
Gain the Perfect Foresight passive: correct Foretell guesses instead grant 125% Armor and Evasion, and 20% damage reduction.

effects.name: Perfect Foresight
effects.description: Correct Foretell guesses grant 125% Armor and Evasion and reduce incoming damage by 20% for two turns.
